# montecarlo_dbt_cloud_webhook_credentials (Resource)

dbt Cloud webhook credentials are a service token and a webhook's HMAC secret Monte Carlo stores for a dbt Cloud connection. dbt Cloud reports each finished job run through the webhook, and Monte Carlo reads the run with the token. Neither secret is ever returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `account_id` (String) Your dbt Cloud account id, the number in the account's URLs.
- `hmac_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The webhook's HMAC secret, shown by dbt Cloud when the webhook is created. Monte Carlo checks each event's signature with it. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `hmac_secret_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `hmac_secret_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `service_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) A dbt Cloud service token that can read the account. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `service_token_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `service_token_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `webhook_id` (String) Id of the dbt Cloud webhook that sends job.run.completed events to Monte Carlo.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Your dbt Cloud access URL followed by /api/v2, such as https://emea.dbt.com/api/v2. Leave it out for https://cloud.getdbt.com/api/v2.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
